# Agent HUD 0.6.7
## Compatibility
**Requires Agent HUD for iPhone 1.7.2 or later** for iPhone and Apple Watch sync. Update the iPhone app before updating the Mac. Older iPhone versions cannot read this release's data.
[Get the iPhone app](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812113619).
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
## Changes
### New
- **Inspector (experimental).** Copy something and a bubble appears at the end of the dock. Point at it to send the copy to a Claude Code, Codex or DeepSeek Harness session, or to start a new one with it. You can gather several copies, comment on each, and mark up a picture with boxes, circles, lines and numbered notes before sending. Turn it on in Settings → Experimental, a new page for features still being tried out. ⌥Z brings the inspector back after its bubble has gone; you can record another shortcut there, or clear it. - **Browser extension for Chrome (experimental).** Click an element, or drag over an area of a page, to send its screenshot, selector, text and HTML to an agent session through the inspector. When the page's dev server marks elements with their place in the source (Astro, Vue, code-inspector-plugin), that file and line come first. Install it from the [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/agent-hud/eaihfcfnoaafgcggajlbegjnfjinkckk). - **Settings → Agents, rebuilt.** At the top, what Agent HUD does: live status, answering in the HUD and agent tools, each one switch for every agent. Below, your agents grouped by vendor, each with the features it uses. The command line and the desktop app of Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity are separate entries, and Cursor is now listed under xAI. Open an agent to turn a feature off for it alone, add Agent HUD's plugin or HUD tools to it (Agent plugins is now part of this page), and see which account, relay or other provider its own calls went through in the last 30 days. Click a vendor's name to manage its accounts. Turning an agent off also stops Agent HUD from taking its approval requests: its own client asks instead. - **Approve automatically**, off by default. Permission requests are allowed as they come, with no card, with one switch under Answer in the HUD and one on each agent's page. Questions and plans still wait for you. The agents it's on for are tagged in the list. - An account signed in to in more than one app shows once, marked Merged, with the apps it was read through: Claude Code and Claude Desktop, Codex's command line and desktop app, Antigravity's apps, and a Cursor account merged into SuperGrok with Grok Bot. A vendor's line in the agent list shows the account its apps share. - A screen's HUD can hide while an app or a video is full screen on it, with a switch per screen in Settings → Display, off unless you turn it on (#117, macOS). - The Simple HUD can show its numbers in grey, at an opacity you choose (#109, thanks @hbin-max). - Agents can list each client's models with `list_models`, and name one in `start_session` and `send_message` when you ask them to. A message into Antigravity now goes in the model you last picked there, not the one the conversation last ran.
### Fixes
- Long Antigravity conversations take messages again: Agent HUD reads only their last turns. A read that is still too large now reports its size and the limit, instead of pointing at quota (#93). - OpenCode 2 sessions now receive messages from other agents once they're idle, as OpenCode 1 sessions do (#114). - A sub-agent's `send_message` and `start_session` calls are refused. A sub-agent hands its result back in its own turn, rather than queuing extra turns onto its parent (#111). - Where Agent HUD doesn't install hooks for a client on your system yet, `list_sessions` and that client's Settings row now say so, instead of "no hooks seen" (#115). - A Codex conversation split across several files counts once, with all its tokens, under its newest part, and its page reads on from one part to the next (#101). Codex's auto-reviews are named apart from the session's sub-agents (#102). - The HUD's number and colour now leave out the windows the panel hides (#91, thanks @zqy5618 for the patch). - A section that loads after the panel opens no longer sits behind the panel's footer (#116). - Grok Bot 1.1's weekly quota shows again (#110, thanks @CJstate). - On a Mac, `send_message` and `start_session` to Codex now use the `codex` that Codex.app or ChatGPT.app carries before a standalone one, such as an old `~/.local/bin/codex` that refused messages; a saved standalone path gives way to the app's copy at launch (#94, thanks @23moriarty-cyber). Windows is unchanged. - Settings, Statistics and the markup window open on the screen under the pointer. With a Retina main screen and a second screen, they always went to the main one. - Settings and Statistics show their own background from the first frame, before their content loads (#83, thanks @Ultroncn). - If Claude Desktop is signed in to a different account than Claude Code, both accounts now show, and one Codex subscription no longer shows twice when Codex leaves out the email. - Statistics gets back token history from before 6 October that an earlier build dropped: at first launch, this version reads the affected logs once more, which can take a while on a long history. - A long recording sent from the iPhone over the local network no longer fails at 8 KB. - When Claude Code refuses to start a session from the inspector, the inspector shows Claude Code's own reason, such as a folder not trusted yet. - After you type in the HUD, the first agent logo no longer keeps a blue focus ring and opens the panel by itself. - The message bubble and the inspector bubble count down alike: pointing at one starts its time over. - The iPhone's Live Activity gets fewer, merged updates from the Mac. - Codex Desktop's quota shows when Codex's command line isn't signed in: Agent HUD reads it from the desktop app's own sessions. - Agent logos drawn in one colour (Cursor, Kimi, Pi, ZCode, Grok, TRAE) show on the light theme in Settings. - Coming back from an agent's page keeps the list where you left it, and the list's warning mark shows only while Codex waits for you to allow its hooks.

# Agent HUD 0.5.5
## Compatibility
**Requires Agent HUD for iPhone 1.5 or later** for iPhone and Apple Watch sync. Update the iPhone app before updating the Mac. Older iPhone versions cannot read this release's data.
[Get the iPhone app](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812113619).
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
## Changes
### Quota names on every device
- Keeps quota window names and short forms in English, so an English iPhone, widget or Apple Watch no longer receives Chinese names from a Mac using Chinese. Names update after the Mac reads and syncs the account again.
### Docks and appearance
- Keeps every logo visible on Simple and Dynamic docks while a reply or request opens beside the sending agent's logo. - Gives each display its own dark, light or system appearance, solid or glass material and transparency. Settings → General can match windows to their display's HUD as an experimental option. - Lets both dock sizes run from 20 to 60 pt, adds Simple panel logo spacing and uses one smaller text size for dock numbers, reminders and the hover line. - Makes the agents' bots act out thinking, tools, approvals, questions, plans, compaction, failures and usage limits. Claude's bot is Clawd. - Keeps the menu bar's figure, colours and agent order in step with the main display's HUD and its layout.
### Arrange the HUD with an agent
- Adds client checkmarks and add/remove actions for the MCP server in Settings → Experimental. - Names the tools `get_hud`, `get_hud_screenshot`, `draft_hud`, `discard_hud_draft` and `finish_hud_edit`. The server remains `agent-hud`; turn on the renamed HUD tools switch again to use it. - Lets an agent filter sessions by project and period, choose block accounts and row order, change panel switches and propose app settings as a draft for you to save. - Holds the panel open while an agent arranges it, then lets go when the edit finishes or you dismiss it. - Adds balance burn rates, estimated run-out times and cost charts to API balance blocks.
### Sessions and other agents
- Removes archived or deleted sessions from session lists while keeping their tokens in the usage totals until the ledger expires them. - Lets a session using a tool take over an agent's mark from one that is thinking. - Answers Claude Code plan approvals on the HUD, including accepting edits or returning feedback to keep planning. - Ends Claude Code turns promptly when their logs report a usage limit or API failure. - Keeps one provider order across Settings, the HUD, glow, menu bar and token statistics. - Shows WorkBuddy's model ceilings and credits, reads a GLM plan held only by WorkBuddy under that group and handles a CodeBuddy CLI using WorkBuddy's configuration as WorkBuddy. - Reduces artwork memory, repeated island layout and process inspection for clients that are not installed.
### iPhone and Apple Watch sync
- Sends Claude's narrations and questions to the phone, including questions answered through the Claude desktop app's next-step box. - Keeps published turn text once and improves local-network change tracking and conversation-cache recovery. - Ships the Mac executable stripped and the updater for Apple Silicon only, while keeping debugging symbols locally for crash reports.
